text:
Skip the full-history check on athena/ci/<job id> branches. On those branches it always fails, because the candidate commit is not yet a verified job ('changes governed content without landing a verified job'), and Athena already treats it as a note; it only costs a runner each time.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml skips the 'the full history' job when the pushed branch starts with athena/ci/; it still runs on main, pull requests and every other branch.
- The required check 'fmt, clippy, tests' does not depend on the skipped job.
- A test or workflow check in the repository shows the condition and that the required check name is unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md gets an entry.
- Do not list a repository-wide fmt, clippy or test run as its own acceptance criterion.
Priority: normal
